info.title: HukID dashboard — DASH-T01 contract baseline
info.description: Four proposed Management/BFF reads. No handlers, SQL grants, UI or sources connected by DASH-T01. Future domain capabilities are reserved, absent from the effective role matrix.

get.description: Contract-only. Live authorization precedes source reads and cursor use. Unknown/duplicate/empty query parameters are rejected. No shared cache; see console-dashboard-contract.md for scope, interval and cursor invariants.

parameters.name: tenantId
parameters.description: Selector, never authority; unknown/inaccessible tenant is 404.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Supply with to; UTC inclusive. Both omitted defaults to previous 24 hours.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: UTC exclusive; from < to <= server now; at most 31 days.

parameters.name: issuerId
parameters.description: Must belong to tenant and current actor scope, otherwise 404. Missing ownership source returns 503 before any data.

200.description: Authorized overview; independent sections may degrade.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque authenticated encrypted cursor, TTL 900s; explicit from/to required on continuation; binds actor/revision/tenant/issuer/window/limit/operation/asOf and position. Live reauthorization before use.

200.description: Authorized allowlisted activity; a failed source returns 503.
